text:
sam_marketing: Hey all — new draft of the product launch post is live in Drive: https://drive.redwoodinference/launch_draft_final.docx. Looking for quick passes on headline tone, hero image, and CTA routing.
priya_product: Reviewing now. Two product asks: 1) include a compact technical aside linking to Appendix A with benchmark methodology, 2) hero should show Dedicated dashboard with 99th-pct latency line visible.
lena_design: Uploaded three hero variants to the drive (screenshot_crop, clean_chart, photo_with_overlay). I prefer screenshot_crop for credibility. Need square + 16:9 crops for socials.
sam_marketing: Square for LinkedIn sponsor posts, 16:9 for blog header. Use screenshot_crop for both. I'll also prepare a short sponsor sentence — legal needs to sign off.
diego_ops: Demo booking note: we'll create region-aware demo rooms (US/EU/APAC). Please include UTM params on CTA links: ?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=launch_q2_2026&utm_region={region} and a param for CTA variant: ctav=variantA|variantB. HubSpot routing plan:
- region=US -> Pipeline: Demo - US
- region=EU -> Pipeline: Demo - EU
- region=APAC -> Pipeline: Demo - APAC (fallback to US)
I'll add webhook to pass email, region, and "interest_tags" property.
eric_legal: Quick legal flags: 1) Sponsor blurb must clearly state partner role (e.g., "integration partner"), 2) need signed logo release before we publish with partner branding, 3) avoid absolute comparative claims in headlines unless backed in Appendix A.
partner_ops: We can provide logo + signed release today. Would like a 24-hour courtesy preview before embargo lift.
sam_marketing: Ok — partner asked to preview the sponsor sentence. I'll draft a neutral line: "In collaboration with [Partner], delivering integrated routing for private deployments." Will ping partner.
priya_product: I'll finish Appendix A (measurement methodology, hardware, raw numbers) by 3pm PT and include links to the eval scripts.
lena_design: Once Appendix charts are ready Ill export PNG/SVG for the blog and socials.
diego_ops: I'll provision demo rooms and set HubSpot routing today. Also can wire a 50/50 AB test for CTA copy. Suggest split copy: "Book a private demo" vs "Schedule a dedicated walkthrough". I'll add ctav param to the links and report conversions.
eric_legal: For benchmarks wording, prefer "up to" phrasing plus a footnote linking Appendix A. No partner overlay text on screenshots without partner approval.
pr-bot: Reminder: proposed embargo lift 2026-05-04 09:00 PT. Partner requested 24-hour preview. If legal/partner need earlier review, flag now.
sam_marketing: Timeline recap: partner logo + release by EOD today, Appendix A by 3pm PT, legal signoff by 5pm PT, final review meeting 2026-05-01 15:00 PT (link: https://meet.redwoodinference/final-launch-review).
partner_ops: Confirmed — we'll send assets by 5pm PT, request preview link 24 hours before embargo.
priya_product: Appendix A ETA 3pm PT. Ill drop raw csv and script links in the doc.
lena_design: :thumbsup: will queue exports after Appendix is posted.
diego_ops: Will confirm HubSpot routing + webhook details in the doc. ETA EOD.
eric_legal: I'll review sponsor blurb and appendix when posted; if logo missing, we remove logo and keep a text mention.
sam_marketing: Thanks team — I'll post the updated draft here in an hour and open a 1-hour final review window after legal signoff. Closing thread when final is published.
